signals.summary: A broad nostalgic swing across the home: 1970s Italian design reissues, Victorian 'skiffers', grandma lampshades and 'granny cool', and the return of '90s decor — patina and personality over the blank slate.
signals.why_now: Wallpaper '1970s Italian design is having a moment' (18h), Apartment Therapy 'Skiffers Are Majorly Trending in 2026' (46h), Country Living 'Grandma's Favorite Lampshades Are Suddenly Cool Again' (46h) and Good Housekeeping 'Vintage Design Trends With Staying Power'. Deep, multi-outlet and directly producible as styled rooms and objects.

signals.summary: The design press declaring the pared-back minimalist era over, replaced by cozy, old-world, colour-and-layer-rich maximalism for 2026.
signals.why_now: Fort Worth Star-Telegram 'Maximalism is the top home decor trend of 2026', realsimple 'Minimalist Interiors Are Officially Out — Cozy, Old-World Trends Are Making a Huge Comeback', and repeated 'moving on from minimalism' features from Better Homes & Gardens and Vogue ('Color Is So Back'). Consistent multi-outlet aesthetic shift; fully producible as rooms.

signals.summary: Practical small-space content — clever storage, furniture that earns its footprint, rooms that read bigger — running as a steady, high-save format.
signals.why_now: Fresh service pieces: 'A Designer Built a Bedroom Above Her Closet to Get More From 375 Square Feet' (21h), '20 Ways People Hack IKEA BILLY Bookshelves for Genius Storage' (21.6h), plus a run of 'make a small living room feel bigger' explainers. Object- and room-led, no people required.

signals.summary: Saturated, dark-painted kitchens and vintage-inspired colour (deep blues, moody greens) as a counter to the all-white kitchen.
signals.why_now: Apartment Therapy 'She Painted Her Small Kitchen Dark — Now It Looks Twice as Big' (1.3h) and 'Joanna Gaines' New Collection Is Full of This Vintage-Inspired Blue' (17h), alongside a '1950s Kitchen custom makeover' feature (15h). Fresh and cleanly producible.

signals.summary: An emerging coined middle ground — 'midimalism' / 'midmalism' — pitched as warm, edited comfort between stark minimalism and full maximalism.
signals.why_now: The Washington Post ran 'Midimalism is the latest home design trend' this week (45h), echoing realsimple's earlier 'Midmalism Is the Feel-Good Decorating Trend Everyone's Trying'. Only two clear independent sources so far — an early, watch-this signal rather than a confirmed wave.
